original_prompt: Create an Ansible playbook that installs the OpenTelemetry Collector (binary or yum/apt repository), configures it to receive OTLP on port 4317 and export to a remote endpoint, and starts it as a systemd service.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: Ansible playbook (YAML)

Task: Create an Ansible playbook that installs the OpenTelemetry Collector (binary or yum/apt repository), configures it to receive OTLP on port 4317 and export to a remote endpoint, and starts it as a systemd service.

Output only the Ansible playbook (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
```yaml
---
- name: Install and configure OpenTelemetry Collector
  hosts: otel_collectors
  become: true
  vars:
    otel_version: "0.92.0"
    otel_remote_endpoint: "https://your-otel-backend.example.com:443"
    otel_remote_headers: 
      Authorization: "Bearer your-token-here"
    otel_config_dir: "/etc/otelcol"
    otel_binary_path: "/usr/local/bin/otelcol"
    otel_user: "otelcol"
    otel_group: "otelcol"
    
  tasks:
    - name: Create OpenTelemetry system group
      group:
        name: "{{ otel_group }}"
        system: true
        state: present

    - name: Create OpenTelemetry system user
      user:
        name: "{{ otel_user }}"
        group: "{{ otel_group }}"
        system: true
        shell: "/usr/sbin/nologin"
        home: "{{ otel_config_dir }}"
        create_home: false
        state: present

    - name: Create OpenTelemetry config directory
      file:
        path: "{{ otel_config_dir }}"
        state: directory
        owner: "{{ otel_user }}"
        group: "{{ otel_group }}"
        mode: "0755"

    - name: Install required packages
      package:
        name:
          - curl
          - systemd
        state: present

    - name: Download OpenTelemetry Collector binary
      get_url:
        url: "https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-releases/releases/download/v{{ otel_version }}/otelcol_{{ otel_version }}_linux_amd64.tar.gz"
        dest: "/tmp/otelcol_{{ otel_version }}_linux_amd64.tar.gz"
        mode: "0644"
        checksum: "sha256:https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-releases/releases/download/v{{ otel_version }}/otelcol_{{ otel_version }}_linux_amd64.tar.gz.sha256"

    - name: Extract OpenTelemetry Collector binary
      unarchive:
        src: "/tmp/otelcol_{{ otel_version }}_linux_amd64.tar.gz"
        dest: "/tmp"
        remote_src: true

    - name: Install OpenTelemetry Collector binary
      copy:
        src: "/tmp/otelcol"
        dest: "{{ otel_binary_path }}"
        mode: "0755"
        owner: "{{ otel_user }}"
        group: "{{ otel_group }}"

    - name: Create OpenTelemetry Collector configuration
      template:
        src: otel-collector-config.yaml.j2
        dest: "{{ otel_config_dir }}/config.yaml"
        owner: "{{ otel_user }}"
        group: "{{ otel_group }}"
        mode: "0644"
      notify: restart otelcol

    - name: Create systemd service file
      template:
        src: otelcol.service.j2
        dest: "/etc/systemd/system/otelcol.service"
        mode: "0644"
      notify: restart otelcol

    - name: Reload systemd daemon
      systemd:
        daemon_reload: true

    - name: Enable and start OpenTelemetry Collector service
      systemd:
        name: otelcol
        enabled: true
        state: started
        daemon_reload: true

  handlers:
    - name: restart otelcol
      systemd:
        name: otelcol
        state: restarted
```

```yaml
---
# templates/otel-collector-config.yaml.j2
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc:
        endpoint: 0.0.0.0:4317
      http:
        endpoint: 0.0.0.0:4318

exporters:
  otlp:
    endpoint: "{{ otel_remote_endpoint }}"
    headers:
      {% for key, value in otel_remote_headers.items() %}
      "{{ key }}": "{{ value }}"
      {% endfor %}
    tls:
      insecure: false

processors:
  batch:

extensions:
  health_check:
  pprof:
    endpoint: :1777
  zpages:
    endpoint: :55679

service:
  extensions: [health_check, pprof, zpages]
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [batch]
      exporters: [otlp]
    metrics:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [batch]
      exporters: [otlp]
    logs:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [batch]
      exporters: [otlp]
```

```yaml
---
# templates/otelcol.service.j2
[Unit]
Description=OpenTelemetry Collector
Documentation=https://opentelemetry.io/docs/collector/
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User={{ otel_user }}
Group={{ otel_group }}
ExecStart={{ otel_binary_path }} --config={{ otel_config_dir }}/config.yaml
Restart=always
RestartSec=5
StandardOutput=journal
StandardError=journal
SyslogIdentifier=otelcol
LimitNOFILE=65536
LimitNPROC=infinity
CapabilityBoundingSet=
NoNewPrivileges=true
PrivateTmp=true
PrivateDevices=true
ProtectSystem=full
ProtectHome=true
ReadWritePaths={{ otel_config_dir }}

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
```
